profile.summary: Touro University California is a graduate and professional university on Mare Island in Vallejo, California. It offers programs in health sciences and public health, and its Graduate School of Education prepares teachers and school administrators and is authorized to recommend teaching credentials in California.

review.notes: Touro University California in Vallejo matches the agenda location, and an OUSD Legistar record shows a prior OUSD MOU with Touro University's education college for teacher credential and intern partnerships, which fits a Talent/HR MOU. Contact details, Mare Island location, programs and CTC credential authority were confirmed on the cited tu.edu pages; the summary is neutral.
